# Nipania Vikash Seva Trust

> Nipania Vikash Seva Trust is a registered non-profit charitable trust in India dedicated to rural community welfare, child education, preventative healthcare camps, women empowerment, and disaster relief. Guided by the core tenets of Seva (Selfless Service), Vikash (Inclusive Progress), and Samarpan (Wholehearted Dedication).

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://nipaniatrust.org
- Tax Benefits: Donations eligible for 50% tax exemption under Section 80G and 12A of the Indian Income Tax Act.
- Location: Balrampur, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Primary Email: info@nipaniatrust.org
- Primary Phone: +91 98765 43210
- UPI ID: nipaniatrust@upi

## Core Programs & Initiatives
- Free Primary Schooling & Educational Kits: Textbooks, stationery, school bags, and daily tutoring for rural children.
- Mobile Health Clinics & Rural Pediatric Camps: Free diagnostic camps, essential medicines, and maternal healthcare drives.
- Emergency Relief & Ration Drives: Food grain packages, clean drinking water, and flood/winter emergency supplies.
- Women Skill Development & Tailoring: Vocational training workshops fostering economic self-reliance for village women.
- Winter Warmth Blanket Distribution: Heavy blankets and thermal clothing distributed to vulnerable village elders and children.
